newsitem.title: USA: US to sell $29.75 bln 2-, 5-yr notes March 25, 26.
newsitem.headline: US to sell $29.75 bln 2-, 5-yr notes March 25, 26.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Wednesday that it will sell $17.25 billion of 2-year notes on March 25 and $12.5 bln of 5-yr notes on March 26 to refund $29.122 billion of securities maturing March 31 and to raise $625 million of new cash.
The notes will be issued on March 31. The two-year notes mature on March 31, 1999 and the five-year notes mature on March 31, 2002.
The CUSIP number for the 2-year notes will be 9128272N1 and for the five-year notes will be 9128272P6.
